notes.zh: 审阅说明：与其他“奇异世界”事件不同，此项的排除条件是“已触发过且拥有生物起源DLC”，没有要求必须拥有该DLC（terraforming_events.txt:503-514）。
notes.en: Review note: unlike the other strange-world entries, this one is only excluded when already triggered AND BioGenesis is owned; it does not require the DLC (terraforming_events.txt:503-514).
